key_insight: A φ-FEM formulation lets the heat equation be solved on moving domains with unfitted meshes by embedding the boundary description through a level-set function.
engineering_relevance: This avoids remeshing at every time step, making transient simulations on complex evolving geometries simpler and more practical in standard finite element workflows.
method: Use an implicit level-set φ to define the time-dependent domain.
Enforce boundary conditions directly in the variational form with φ-FEM.
Combine spatial discretization with lowest-order discontinuous Galerkin time stepping.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an optimal a priori error estimate in L2(0,T;H1) under mild time-step/mesh-size coupling, and numerical tests show the expected convergence plus second-order L∞(0,T;L2) accuracy.
watch_item: The theory requires regularity of the level-set function and a mild restriction linking time step to mesh size, which may constrain robustness in highly irregular moving boundaries.
paper_title: A φ-FEM approach for time-dependent domains with unfitted meshes
